title: Thomas Talbert Jazz Orchestra Louisiana Suite CD Sea Breeze Big Band Jazz
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
The Thomas Talbert Jazz Orchestra - Louisiana Suite & Other
Instrumentals (Sea Breeze Jazz CDSB-107-2, 1988). Arranged and conducted
by Thomas Talbert. Recorded October 3, 4, 5, 1977 in Hollywood,
California; remixed with Dolby SR in May 1988 for a new digital master.

Louisiana Suite (total time 21:27)
1. Royal Street (4:20)
2. Too Wet To Walk (4:39)
3. Watermelon Days (4:39)
4. Grieve Softly (2:07)
5. Shipping Out (5:39)

6. It's The Style (4:00)
7. No Time To Be Blue (5:08)
8. Don't Delay (5:03)
9. Strolling Home (2:07)
10. Is It Time To Let You Go (4:59)
11. Hard Dollar (4:01)

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
